lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters forming a geometric grid on the lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the primary circular blobs to create a lattice-like visual structure across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear ridges visible on the upper flank, defined by a distinct intensity gradient transition from high-luminance highlights on the dorsal edge to low-luminance shadows on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density, labyrinthine distribution of small high-luminance spots that are significantly more disorganized than the geometric pattern of the lateral flank.
